title: Bicomposite Nanotherapeutic Architecture with Kinetic Targeting, Molecular Biocomputing, Enzymatic Conditional Logic, and Programmatic Synthetic Lethality for Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
description: Audited computational research package separating public human transcriptomic source data, derived bioinformatics outputs, and synthetic in-silico pharmacodynamic data. Computational proof of concept; not clinical validation.
